top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 82, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
GFNY Philippines' rolling countryside roads forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 82 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Philippines' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
GFNY Philippines' rolling countryside roads rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
When someone attacks on rolling countryside roads, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Philippines. Train it until it feels boring.
At GFNY Philippines, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 82 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At GFNY Philippines, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
2-minute all-out efforts on rolling countryside roads. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
The aerobic base that lets you ride rolling countryside roads at tempo for 82 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 82 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.

race_overlay.heat: September in Iloilo City, Philippines (last held; earlier 2019 edition was in Bohol) can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before GFNY Philippines. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for GFNY Philippines’s 82 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at GFNY Philippines. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at GFNY Philippines requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on rolling countryside roads to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Road Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 82 miles of rolling countryside roads in Iloilo City, Philippines (last held; earlier 2019 edition was in Bohol).
